one_line: Historic, dog-friendly restaurant, sports bar and live music venue
price_note: No text-based prices are published on 7milehouse.com: /menu shows six menu images (Appetizers & Salads; Sandwiches, Pasta, Kids & Sides; Entrees & Desserts; two further unlabeled pages; Dog Menu; Brunch Menu) with no readable text, and /order only links out to a third-party Toast Tab ordering page. Per the /ubebakeoff page, the 6th annual Ube Bake-Off (Sept 30-Oct 5, 2026) has no entry fee, is dine-in only via the 'Ube Bake-Off Sampler' (comes with 2 ballots to sample and vote on 4 competing desserts; no tickets needed though reservations are recommended), with the winning baker earning the 'Ube Bake Off Champ' title, a $100 gift certificate, and a chance to sell their dessert at 7 Mile House in Oct/Nov.
flags: Glenn: 'Brisbane • Goods'

Hours: the home page, /menu and /contact agree (Sun 11:30am-8pm; Mon and Wed-Sat 11:30am-9pm, bar to 10pm Fri-Sat; closed Tue) and their Instagram bio says 'Open Wed - Mon w/ Sun brunch'; only the /ubebakeoff page's generic footer groups the days differently, so the three-page line is carried

Menu is image/PDF only on /menu (Appetizers & Salads; Sandwiches, Pasta, Kids & Sides; Entrees & Desserts; two more unlabeled pages; Dog Menu; Brunch Menu) - no text prices could be extracted; /order redirects to a third-party Toast Tab ordering site (out of scope for this research), so prices_published is false and items is empty.

Ube Bake-Off page: 6th annual event, Sept 30-Oct 5, 2026, at 7 Mile House. Free to vote (no entry fee); dine-in only - order the 'Ube Bake-Off Sampler' to taste 4 competition desserts and receive 2 ballots to vote (hand to server); no tickets required, reservations recommended. Prizes: the '7 Mile House Ube Bake Off Champ' title, a $100 gift certificate, a chance to sell the winning dessert at 7 Mile House in Oct/Nov, plus a blog/social media feature. A separate link on that page for nominating or competing was not followed.
No email address found on the home page or the /contact page.
Phone number appears in two printed formats across pages ('(415) 467-2343' on the home page vs '415-467-2343' on /ubebakeoff, /menu, and /contact) - same number, formatting difference only.
Menu prices are on their Toast ordering page, which refuses automated fetches (403), so the page says the prices are on the site rather than printing any
